Figure 1 Assembly

inv4m

2026-03-09

Load pre-built panels

Panels B–D come from plot_synteny_and_repeats.Rmd. Panel E (genotype map) with Panel F (chr4 inset) come from plot_genotype_get_correlated_loci.Rmd as plot_with_inset.

p_bcd <- readRDS(file.path(paths$intermediate, "fig1_panel_BCD.rds"))
p_ef  <- readRDS(file.path(paths$intermediate, "fig1_panel_E.rds"))

Panel A placeholder

Panel A (breeding scheme) is a hand-drawn/Inkscape illustration added in post-production. We reserve space with the correct aspect ratio.

p_a <- ggdraw() +
  draw_label("Panel A\n(breeding scheme — added in Inkscape)",
             size = 18, color = "gray60")

Panels E + F (pre-built)

p_ef is the full bottom row from plot_genotype_get_correlated_loci.Rmd: E = whole-genome genotype map, F = chr4 zoom inset, with spike-calibrated brackets and panel labels already included.

p_ef

Full Figure 1

fig1 <- plot_grid(
  p_a,
  p_bcd,
  p_ef,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(0.23, 0.37, 0.40),
  labels = c("A", "", ""),
  label_size = 45, label_fontface = "bold",
  label_x = 0, label_y = 1)

fig1

ggsave(file.path(paths$figures, "Figure_1.png"),
       plot = fig1, width = 18, height = 19, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave(file.path(paths$figures, "Figure_1.svg"),
       plot = fig1, width = 18, height = 19, device = "svg",
       fix_text_size = TRUE)
